question: What transformative effect does thorough knowledge of this mantra nature produce?
premises: Thorough knowledge of this nature has a decisive power.
Conditioned existence is ordinarily a state of bondage.
Knowledge can transform the status of existence.
inference: Therefore, by thorough knowledge of this, conditioned existence becomes the ground of liberation.
plain_english: By the power of thoroughly knowing this, worldly existence becomes the ground of liberation.
